title: Tensor commutes with Hom from a finite projective ordinary module
statement: Let R be a commutative semiring and M,P,Q be R-modules. If M is finite [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] and projective [def-weil-pbc-projective-module], the canonical map P tensor_R Hom_R(M,Q)→Hom_R(M,P tensor_R Q), sending p tensor f to (x↦p tensor f(x)), is an R-linear equivalence. There are no hypotheses on P or Q.
